Listen to this Rain song 'Yeh Thandi Hawayen' sung by Kishore Kumar and Asha Bhosle from the Super hit movie 'Prem Nagar', Music by S.D.Burman starring Rajesh Khanna, Hema Malini, Prem Chopra and Asrani only on Classics
Movie: Prem Nagar (1974)
Starring: Rajesh Khanna, Hema Malini, Prem Chopra, Asrani
Music: S.D. Burman
Singer: Kishore Kumar, Asha Bhosle
Directed by: K. S. Prakash Rao
